description: Search and filter job listings from Arbeitnow — a global job board with thousands of remote and on-site opportunities.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job listings to return. The Arbeitnow API returns up to 15 jobs per page.
maxItems.title: Max items

remote.description: When enabled, only remote-friendly jobs are returned.
remote.title: Remote only

searchQuery.description: Keyword to filter jobs by title or description (case-insensitive substring match). Leave blank to return all jobs.
searchQuery.title: Search query

tags.description: Filter jobs by one or more category tags (e.g. ["Software Development", "IT"]). A job must match ALL specified tags. Tags are job categories as used by Arbeitnow (not technology names).
tags.title: Tags (tech stack / category)

title: Arbeitnow Job Listings Scraper Input
